about: San Francisco Open Data portal (data.sfgov.org, now served from data.sf.gov on Socrata): search the city's dataset catalog, read dataset metadata and columns, and query, export or map dataset records with SoQL.

commands.summary: Search or browse the SF open data catalog by keyword, category, tag, publishing department or asset type; returns dataset ids, names and stats

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text keywords, e.g. 'building permits'. Omit to browse by filters only.

params.name: categories
params.description: Catalog category, e.g. 'Housing and Buildings', 'Health and Social Services', 'Economy and Community', 'City Management and Ethics', 'COVID-19'. list-catalog-filters returns the full list.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tag to filter by, e.g. 'transit', 'business', 'gis'

params.name: attribution
params.description: Publishing agency or department attribution, e.g. 'SFMTA'

params.name: department
params.description: Publishing Department facet value, e.g. '311'. list-catalog-filters returns the allowed values.

params.name: only
params.description: Restrict to one asset type, e.g. dataset, map, chart, filter, story, file, href

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip (0, 20, 40...)

commands.summary: Fetch rows from a dataset as JSON with SoQL filtering, sorting, column selection, aggregation and paging. Use get-dataset to find column field names.

params.name: datasetId
params.description: Dataset id (four-four format, e.g. i98e-djp9 for Building Permits)

params.name: where
params.description: SoQL filter, e.g. street_name='Market' or filed_date > '2024-01-01'

params.name: order
params.description: SoQL sort, e.g. 'filed_date DESC'

params.name: select
params.description: Columns or aggregates to return, e.g. 'permit_number,status' or 'count(*)' for the row count

params.name: group
params.description: SoQL GROUP BY columns, used with aggregates in select, e.g. 'status'

params.name: q
params.description: Full-text search across all text columns

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum rows to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Rows to skip, for paging

commands.summary: Get a dataset's metadata: name, description, category, publishing department, update times, view and download counts, and its columns (fieldName, type, description)

params.name: datasetId
params.description: Dataset id (four-four format, e.g. i98e-djp9)

commands.summary: Export dataset rows as CSV text, with the same SoQL filter, sort and limit options as query-dataset-records

params.name: datasetId
params.description: Dataset id (four-four format, e.g. vw6y-z8j6 for 311 cases)

params.name: where
params.description: SoQL filter expression

params.name: order
params.description: SoQL sort, e.g. 'requested_datetime DESC'

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated columns to include

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum rows (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Rows to skip

commands.summary: Fetch rows of a geographic dataset (neighborhoods, districts, stops) as GeoJSON features with geometry, with optional SoQL filtering

params.name: datasetId
params.description: Id of a dataset with a geometry column (e.g. j2bu-swwd, Analysis Neighborhoods)

params.name: where
params.description: SoQL filter, e.g. nhood='Mission'

params.name: select
params.description: Columns to return, e.g. 'nhood,the_geom'

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum features (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Features to skip

commands.summary: List the catalog's filter values: categories, Publishing Department options and popular tags, for use with search-datasets
Quick dataset title suggestions for a partial keyword; use search-datasets to get ids

params.name: q
params.description: Partial keyword

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum suggestions (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)
